note: v9 was not edited. v10 omits only the records mapped below. Source rows and earlier registers stay.

records.reason: Covering a short pattern and redrawing it is the same result as copying a short grid from memory.
A three-strand lanyard is the same braid as a cord that stays together at the ends.
A slipped knot you can release is the release case already inside tying a knot that holds and unties.
Comparing a firm knot with a slipped knot is the choice already required when the loop must come undone.
A scarf knot that stays when you turn your head is the same result as tying a scarf so it stays and sits in place.
A charged comb moving foil and a charged comb moving a thin stream are the same observation.

kept_separate.reason: A stick stays up through a step. A card ends in a catch.
A ball and a book fail in different ways.
A tie is checked for a crease. A towel is checked for staying rolled.
A fan and an even row are different spreads.
A box and an envelope close differently.
One hem is checked before sewing. The other must come out without a tear.
One bow is tested with a tug. The other is tested by where it sits.
Three balls and two in one hand are different patterns.
